conclusions: The previously identified C10 shop rear-wall secondary peak is fixed at the measured ROI/six centers: row304 red darkening4.5 falls to1.975 at313 and0 at322; the new GPU AO rises monotonically across the six saved centers. Not a whole-scene AO proof.
Actual city flags: 23Toon+1Standard cast/receive; 4Toon+2Shader+2Basic do not cast and do receive. The four Toon bins include all six connecting stair groups, not merely incidental upstream props.

At current20/21 views the independent four-Toon-only override changes737/62pixels respectively; original/restored pixels are exactly equal. Main wall/balcony/rear steel-stair shadows remain visibly intact in inspected images, but connection stairs themselves still have cast=false.

Legacy shutter HDR remains unchanged versus C8/C10 in the two saved ROIs; dark detail remains visible. White light-box remains creamy near-white, local3x3 AO difference0. Station light strip remains affected slightly at its sampled edge; no generic emission/AO exemption was implemented.
limits: C10 entire-city flags are source-derived inference; only two lamp batches have historical actual runtime flag records. CPU bin audit lacks attribute hashes; unique triangles/type/worldBounds matching is explicitly weaker than GPU byte signatures.
Only two fixed building views in shadow ABA; no claim all affected foundation/steps/road/poles/flowers retain desired shadows. Temporary four-bin cast=true is diagnostic only, not shipped source.
No performance measured here; separate root normal baseline. Source files and nine actual assets stayed unchanged; all loading cancellations retained.
No demand for zero fluctuation everywhere: all14 main repeated pairs and6shadow pairs are identical here, and bothABA restores are exact; whole-scene visual quality remains a separate review.
